item.title: Gas boilers to be replaced with heat pumps in more than 200 council houses
item.description: Ageing gas boilers will be replaced with heat pumps in more than 200 council houses in Southampton.

item.title: The three ways we got to Woolston before the Itchen Bridge
item.description: The beautiful River Itchen, a fantastic waterway and a natural wonder, was also for many centuries a significant geographical obstacle, blocking easy expansion of Southampton’s public transport system.

item.title: New £22.3m investment fund for Hampshire projects launched
item.description: A new £22.3 million investment fund has opened for Hampshire businesses, residents, councils and universities to put forward ambitious project ideas.

item.title: 'An unrelenting month of festive madness' - top chef reveals his crazy Christmas
item.description: 'An unrelenting month of festive madness' - Utilita Bowl head chef Adam Duebel gives an insight into the craziness of Christmas as a chef

item.title: The 'beautiful' New Forest walk through varied paths and free-roaming ponies
item.description: The Burbush Walk in the New Forest in Hampshire has been praised for its "beautiful" views and wildlife, such as free-roaming ponies

item.title: Footage shows disabled woman being asked to leave pub for having assistance dog
item.description: Footage shows moment blind woman asked to leave a pub for having an assistance dog.

item.title: Southampton campaigners hit out at ‘ruthless’ asylum plans
item.description: Campaigners have launched a direct challenge to the Home Secretary to condemn 'ruthless' asylum reforms they say threaten refugee rights.

item.title: Plan for off-licence to sell alcohol near two Gosport nurseries prompts concerns

item.description: A new cocktail bar in Bitterne Park has been granted permission to serve alcohol and play both live and recorded music.
